marketScope: US listed common equities and ADRs only

rules.name: Extreme drawdown with continuing volatility
rules.triggerSummary: At least 60% below the 120-session adjusted high with fresh independent price agreement.

rules.name: Trading halt or volatile resumption
rules.triggerSummary: Verified exchange or regulatory halt, suspension, limit event, or resumption.

rules.name: Delisting or exchange-compliance danger
rules.triggerSummary: Official delisting, minimum-price, late-filing, or exchange-compliance notice.

rules.name: Liquidity collapse or abnormal gap risk
rules.triggerSummary: Low estimated average dollar volume combined with an abnormal move or relative-volume spike.

rules.name: Volatility-regime spike
rules.triggerSummary: At least a 12% daily move, or at least a 7% move with four-times relative volume.

rules.name: Crowded short, squeeze, or positioning risk
rules.triggerSummary: Requires dependable short-interest, borrow-cost, and options-positioning data.

rules.name: Accounting, auditor, or restatement risk
rules.triggerSummary: Verified restatement, auditor resignation, material weakness, or accounting investigation.

rules.name: Material regulator or law-enforcement action
rules.triggerSummary: Material official SEC, DOJ, FTC, court, or regulator action.

rules.name: FDA hold, recall, rejection, or pivotal-trial failure
rules.triggerSummary: Verified clinical hold, rejection, recall, safety signal, or pivotal failure.

rules.name: Bankruptcy, going-concern, covenant, or refinancing stress
rules.triggerSummary: Verified bankruptcy, going-concern, covenant, payment, restructuring, or refinancing danger.

rules.name: Dilution, ATM, secondary offering, or convertible financing
rules.triggerSummary: Material new share, ATM, offering, convertible, warrant, or dilution event.

rules.name: Earnings, guidance, margin, or cash-flow break
rules.triggerSummary: Verified downside earnings or guidance event with material causal transmission.

rules.name: Major customer, supplier, or contract loss
rules.triggerSummary: Verified concentrated customer, contract, supplier, or production loss.

rules.name: Cyberattack, data breach, or operational outage
rules.triggerSummary: Verified cyberattack, ransomware, material breach, or prolonged outage.

rules.name: Sudden leadership or governance break
rules.triggerSummary: Unexpected senior leadership exit, board conflict, or insider misconduct.

rules.name: Merger deal-break or financing failure
rules.triggerSummary: Verified termination, financing failure, regulatory block, court loss, or shareholder opposition.

rules.name: Geopolitical, tariff, sanction, or supply-chain shock
rules.triggerSummary: Verified direct or second-order issuer exposure with high causal-transmission confidence.

rules.name: Rate, inflation, currency, or commodity sensitivity break
rules.triggerSummary: Held until issuer-specific sensitivity thresholds are validated.

rules.name: Source contradiction or data-integrity failure
rules.triggerSummary: Material unresolved evidence contradiction blocks directional promotion.

rules.name: Extreme valuation with confirmed momentum reversal
rules.triggerSummary: Held until valuation, slowing-growth, and reversal thresholds are independently validated.
